wire_rule: approved shapes. Version 13 only; no new tag, bit or row. A non-auto trait header may carry UNSAFE (CONST stays rejected). An impl header's existing unsafe and negative booleans are admitted for any trait impl; inherent impls and constant stay rejected, and versions 12 and 10 keep their fences. Under version 13 an unsafe impl's methods, with or without a receiver, are admitted through the conversion method family, gated on the same version-13 fact that admits the impl's unsafe byte; primitive methods keep refusing unsafe impls (under version 13 every primitive method is also a conversion method, so that refusal is not final), and negative and constant stay rejected in both families. In every version a negative impl maps no trait member: one that maps them is rejected with `auto or negative trait implementations cannot declare members`, and a positive impl keeps `source implementation omits an actual trait member mapping`. Each consumer re-proves, for every imported impl, required_unsafe = trait.UNSAFE && !negative; unsafe == required_unsafe (E0199, E0200, E0198), and completes a non-auto negative impl as NegativeValidated with no requirement, member or coverage proof; it is never positive evidence

observations: the provider without its four negative impls, exported by main under module-branches-v12 and module-nominals-v10, is rejected first with `named, associated or generic alias transport requires its wider profile`; under module-bodies-v13 it meets `source const/auto/unsafe traits require a wider explicit profile`. The full provider is therefore not an older-version trait-fence control; the unsafe-only control shows that fence
the receiver-less `make` of the unsafe Searcher impls for u8 and Counter is refused by the primitive method family and admitted by the conversion family; the trusted client calls both
limits: a trait-impl method under an impl that captures a lifetime (`&T`, `&mut T`) fails in the exporter with `source function early/captured callable frame transport is not implemented`; core's `DerefMut for &mut T` and `Error for &E` need it lifted. The provider's negative impls on references map no member, and its method impls are on u8 and Counter
